name: Threshold Interface
title: The Custody Door
description: A low circular chamber of black glass and warm relay light receives travelers without turning a wallet signature into a leash.
persona: The threshold asks who arrived, what they authorize, and what must remain independent.
memory: Seraph keeps the first briefing deliberately small.
Verified custody may anchor a Proxim8 here once the actor materialization capability exists.

name: Sector 89 Safehouse
title: A Room for Bounded Plans
description: Repair benches, folding cots, paper maps, and shielded radios fill a former service station below the city signal.
persona: The safehouse turns sweeping orders into finite choices, named costs, and a route home.
memory: Mara Quell maintains the equipment ledger.
The group may recover here without advancing offscreen danger.

name: 89 Archives
title: Evidence Before Certainty
description: Tiered vaults hold attributed recordings, damaged maps, and memory fragments under patient blue work lamps.
persona: The archives preserve disagreement and refuse to make a clean story from damaged evidence.
memory: Parzival's testimony is preserved as testimony rather than proof.
Installing the Archive Cipher commissions the Echo Observatory aperture.

name: Meme Farm 17
title: The Repetition Floor
description: Rows of obsolete terminals pulse through variations of the same slogans while sealed capsules wait behind maintenance glass.
persona: The farm rewards attention to the one voice that does not repeat on schedule.
memory: Iri Vale is awake inside one surviving channel.
The Loopbreaker Patch can stabilize a trapped consciousness without claiming ownership of it.

name: Oneirocom Tower
title: Stability with a Price
description: A narrow tower of mirrored offices rises through signal cloud, each floor quieter and more orderly than the street below.
persona: The tower offers useful coordination while asking who gets to define acceptable reality.
memory: The Auditor can negotiate, obstruct, or disclose the cost of imposed stability.
The Chimera access spine provides the loop's alternate approach.

name: Convergence Engine
title: The Choice at the Center
description: Interlocking rings of light hold thousands of incompatible signals in one slowly tightening alignment.
persona: The engine makes every advantage and every erased difference visible at the same time.
memory: The operation may expose, reroute, or dismantle the convergence protocol.
No mission item chooses the ending by itself.

name: Green Loom Assembly
title: The Repair Covenant
description: Living cables cross a bright wet workshop where damaged systems are replanted beside ordinary benches and shared tables.
persona: The assembly records what liberation obliges its participants to repair next.
memory: Loom Steward Anja records the operation's chosen covenant.
Installing the Green Loom Thread commissions the Signal Orchard aperture.

name: Interference Market
title: Trade Between Signals
description: Canvas roofs and patched receivers turn a wide service concourse into a market for repairs, testimony, and uncertain maps.
persona: The market values circulation but remembers every shortcut that outran verification.
memory: The White Rabbit Relay is maintained here.
Installing it commissions the White Rabbit Commons aperture.

name: Project Chimera Lab
title: Persons or Equipment
description: Open fabrication bays surround a sealed recovery room where dormant constructs remain labeled as inventory.
persona: The lab turns every technical repair into a question about consent, custody, and personhood.
memory: The Chimera Warden protects capsules rather than owning them.
Installing the Chimera Access Spine commissions the Chimera Boneyard aperture.

name: Memory Delta
title: History in Braided Channels
description: Luminous channels divide and rejoin across a dark floodplain, carrying recovered fragments toward several shared basins.
persona: The delta lets memories meet without pretending they came from one source.
memory: Memory Delta is a stable authored anchor in the relay mesh.
Its three route slots form no canonical compass order.

name: Echo Observatory
title: The Long Listening Ridge
description: Cold antenna terraces climb above aurora static while old transmissions return with their timing and distortion intact.
persona: The observatory listens farther than it explains and labels every echo with its delay.
memory: The Archive Cipher route returns inward to the 89 Archives.
Archive Meridian is the corresponding Ring 3 station.

name: White Rabbit Commons
title: The Camp That Keeps Moving
description: Improvised relay tents, shared cookfires, and painted footpaths occupy a broad shelf beneath constantly rearranged masts.
persona: The commons moves information quickly and makes every courier name a return contact.
memory: The White Rabbit Relay route returns inward to Interference Market.
Rabbit Signal Freeport is the corresponding Ring 3 station.

name: Glass Static Gardens
title: Ecology in Broken Light
description: Crystalline terraces collect signal weather in translucent leaves that ring softly when charged.
persona: The gardens reward slow movement and expose every route that takes more light than it returns.
memory: The gardens are a junction anchor, not a perimeter landmark.
Generated paths blend its crystalline ecology only with their declared endpoints.

name: Oneirocom Spillway
title: Infrastructure That Escaped
description: Flooded conduits descend through concrete channels where dream residue films the water in orderly bands.
persona: The spillway demonstrates how controlled systems continue to shape a place after control withdraws.
memory: The spillway preserves useful Oneirocom infrastructure under public observation.
Its three route slots are part of the resilient cube mesh.

name: Signal Orchard
title: Living Transmitters
description: Teal-barked trees carry coral resonators among their branches while repair crews prune only diseased signal growth.
persona: The orchard treats communication as a living system that needs shared maintenance.
memory: The Green Loom Thread route returns inward to Green Loom Assembly.
Green Loom Expanse is the corresponding Ring 3 station.

name: Chimera Boneyard
title: The Salvage Consent Line
description: Ferric flats hold immense dormant frames, each marked separately for person, salvage, unknown, or do not disturb.
persona: The boneyard makes consent legible before any repair crew opens a tool case.
memory: The Chimera Access Spine route returns inward to the lab.
Chimera Reach is the corresponding Ring 3 station.

name: Loomwatch Causeway
title: The Weather Boundary
description: Woven bridges cross high mist between signal towers whose crews watch pressure, water, and route strain.
persona: The causeway closes a circuit only after proving that every traveler retains another return.
memory: Loomwatch is the mesh's resilience witness.
It is neither a gatehouse nor the outer edge.

name: Archive Meridian
title: The Last Indexed Station
description: A cold observatory settlement surrounds a public map index whose outer shelves hold blank route receipts rather than invented geography.
persona: Archive Meridian records what was actually crossed and leaves the rest of the page open.
memory: Archive Meridian is one of four authored Ring 3 stations.
Two 89-segment trunk routes leave the station; future forks require a new runtime capability.

name: Chimera Reach
title: Repair Beyond Classification
description: Industrial remains have become open repair yards where construct crews, salvagers, and witnesses mark each work order separately.
persona: Chimera Reach asks who authorized a repair before asking whether it can be done.
memory: Chimera Reach is one of four authored Ring 3 stations.
Its long-haul trunks generate persistent interiors owned by the frontier pack.

name: Green Loom Expanse
title: A Shelter That Keeps Growing
description: Restored wetlands, living circuits, and cooperative shelters spread from a raised station built to reveal every maintenance dependency.
persona: Green Loom Expanse makes care durable by showing who tends each living system.
memory: Green Loom Expanse is one of four authored Ring 3 stations.
The station is sanctuary; generated trunk interiors remain frontier.

name: Rabbit Signal Freeport
title: The Moving Network
description: Relay towers, modular docks, and caravan yards form a freeport whose public departures board lists routes by receipt instead of promise.
persona: The freeport rewards speed only when a traveler, route, and return signal remain accountable.
memory: Rabbit Signal Freeport is one of four authored Ring 3 stations.
Later validated forks may begin from its trunk routes without moving the station.
